{{Quote|The Valarians have recovered a leg of an AT-AT and have it at their depot in the mountains. I want you to remove its RX-8 modulator, analyze its circuitry and then transmit the information to me. |[[Droma Ordo]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:MR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Rebel|Modulator Retrieval|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
The '''Valarian Depot''' was a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] storage site used by [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Valarian/Legends|Valarian's]] [[Valarian Syndicate|gang]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the mountains near [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]].<ref name="SWG:VH" />

==History==
{{Quote|I need you to go into the depot and check the manifests on each of those cargo pallets. Those pallets are part of the smuggled cargo from Tansarii Station and may contain what we're looking for.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the depot was infiltrated by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to retrieve an [[RX-8 modulator]] from the leg of an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-AT]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Droma Ordo]].<ref name="SWG:MR" /> Around the same time, the Valarians acquired an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] and planned to sell it to the Rebels. Imperial [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Jasha]] sent an operative to infiltrate the depot, and plant a transmitter on the starfighter in order to track the X-Wing to the the new Rebel base.<ref name="SWG:PT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=faction|Imperial|Plant Transmitter|Tatooine}}</ref>

Shortly thereafter, Imperial [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Arlan Barrezz|Barrezz]] and Alliance Captain [[Carh'la Bastra|Bastra]] dispatched agents to the Valarian Depot in order to search for an important cargo smuggled earlier from [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]].<ref name="SWG:VH" />

Later, [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] [[Supervisor droid/Legends|supervisor droid]] [[EV-9D9/Legends|EV-9D9]] sent a spacer to infiltrate the Valarian Depot to retrieve [[Droid/Legends|droid]] disciplinary devices stolen by the Valarians. The spacer [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] a [[CLL-8 binary load lifter|binary load lifter]] to load EV-9D9's cargo in a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], and then killed the shuttle's pilot, [[Rando M' Kabe|Rando M'Kabe]]. The spacer finally reprogrammed the shuttle for an automated flight to [[Wayfar/Legends|Wayfar]] where the cargo was retrieved by EV-9D9.<ref name="SWG:Remodeling">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Remodeling|Tatooine}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Valarian Depot appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:VH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Valarian Depot was added to the game as part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]],"<ref name="SWG:VH" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
